name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: A static recompilation of the North American Nintendo 64 release, running natively with modern resolutions, frame rates and controller support.
author_notes: Provide your own copy of the game in Zelda64Recomp's own main menu the first time it runs. Any format works — it converts the ROM itself, and never changes your file. Its saves stay its own, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Zelda64Recompiled\saves. Zelda64Recomp is made and maintained by its own authors, under GPL-3.0.
notes: Identity taken from the No-Intro dump 'Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA).z64' and verified against a copy this project's own check accepts. The upstream README states it accepts only the US release and converts other formats itself, which is what rom_delivery=in_app_menu encodes.

filenames: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA).z64
